name: How important is proper sanding during the drywall finishing process?

mainEntity.name: How important is proper sanding during the drywall finishing process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper sanding is critically important for achieving a smooth, seamless drywall finish. Inadequate sanding leaves visible ridges, bumps, or depressions that will be accentuated once painted, especially under certain lighting conditions. Over-sanding can expose the paper face of the drywall, which needs re-priming or patching. The goal is to blend the feathered edges of the joint compound with the drywall surface seamlessly. Using appropriate sandpaper grit and proper technique ensures a professional-looking result that effectively hides all seams and fasteners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper sanding is crucial to create a smooth, seamless finish, preventing visible imperfections after painting. It blends compound edges with the drywall.
